newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Japan bars Hong Kong television crew from isles.
newsitem.headline: Japan bars Hong Kong television crew from isles.

text.p: The Japanese navy on Friday turned back a Hong Kong television crew trying to land on a group of disputed islands in the East China Sea.
Television Broadcasts Ltd said the Japanese vessel intercepted its journalists as they approached the Diaoyu Islands about 300 km (190 miles) west of Okinawa.
The Japanese had also barred a reporter from the local Ming Pao Daily News from landing on the islands on Wednesday, the newspaper said on Thursday.
The islands, known as the Senkakus in Japan, are claimed by Japan, China and Taiwan. A row broke out between China and Japan in July when the Japanese built a lighthouse on one of them.
